title: service-automation: the flow-name collision log says "arming <first> by package id" for a name two packages hold, which E1 now refuses (ADR-0150 E1 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQXLfvyB5R53VDm3Ka

Filing gate: ④ coordination node. This is the open question on child E1 #31672 of the epic #31527 (ADR-0150), raised in the dev's round-2 report 6730847235 on PR #31738 (recommended A, seat agrees). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: after #31738, when two packages hold the same flow name, `registerFlow` arms neither flow, and the boot log carries a refusal that names both packages. But `resolveFlowPrecedence`'s collision line (`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-precedence.ts`, the `' by package id'` branch) still prints "arming package '<first>' by package id, and shadowing N other definition(s)" before that refusal. An operator reading the boot log is told a flow is live when the engine refuses it.
Reader: the `domain:server` seat, after PR #31738 merges.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `flow name collision arming by package id log` → #31672 and #31738 only, neither on point (they are E1 itself).
class: b · type: Bug
Part of #31527. Blocked-by: #31672

## 维护者速读

两个软件包有同名流程时，引擎现在两个都不启用，并报错列出两个包。但启动日志里前面还有一行写着「按包 id 启用了第一个」，和实际不符。这张卡改掉这行措辞。

## What to build

- In the two-package-holder case, the collision line says that neither definition is armed and points to the refusal line. Other cases (an override with its base, a package with an environment row) keep their wording byte for byte.
- Update the pinned wording in `packages/cli/src/utils/format.boot-warning-classes.test.ts` and in any other test that pins the line (find each by searching for the string).
- Pins: the two-package case reads "neither armed". CONTROL: the other collision classes are unchanged. Ablation: restore the old branch and the pin goes red.
- Clause-②: no (log text only). Metadata-protocol: none.
